cssVars: Field, month keys and popup surface
Day cell size and weekday width

propDocs.DatePicker.mode: One date or a start/end range with two inputs.
propDocs.DatePicker.required: Require a date before form submission.
propDocs.DatePicker.closeOnSelect: Close after choosing a date or complete range.
propDocs.DatePicker.dismissible: Allow Escape and outside presses to dismiss.
propDocs.DatePicker.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
propDocs.DatePickerContent.side: Preferred side of the date field.
